name: Orient Green Power Company Ltd
title: Orient Green Power Company Ltd - 533263 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Wind IPP with FY26 PAT of INR 72 crore (up 70%) on favourable wind and interest refund, but Q4 loss before tax INR 16.4 crore; 1 GW target depends on external equity that management could not timeline.

utilisation.quote: the wind availability was somewhat lower compared to the similar period in the previous year

capex.peers_comment: Every wind company in India had the same issue in Q4.
capex.quote: We have successfully added 9.9 megawatts of wind capacity in this fiscal.

triggers.label: Q4 wind availability lower YoY
triggers.quote: the wind availability was somewhat lower compared to the similar period in the previous year

triggers.label: Solar 17.6 MW under construction
triggers.quote: We are also in the process of constructing 17.6 megawatts of solar capacity, which will be commissioned in Q1

triggers.label: 1 GW target unfunded, no timeline
triggers.quote: I am not in a position to give you a timeline right now.

guidance.quote: which will be commissioned in Q1 and probably will enter full production during the course of Q2

guidance.value: INR 14 crore revenue, INR 10 crore EBITDA
guidance.quote: we should get again about INR 14 crores of revenue and about INR 10 crores of EBITDA

red_flags.label: Q4 pre-tax loss INR 16.4 crore
red_flags.quote: Loss before exceptional items and tax was about INR 16.4 crores during this quarter

red_flags.label: Evasive on 1 GW funding and promoter control
red_flags.quote: We cannot talk about all this until it happens.

evasions.quote: I am not in a position to give you a timeline right now.
Sir, I cannot discuss all this on a public call Faisal.
